notes.title: Hidden Glade takes part in Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
I am very pleased to announce that Hidden Glade is participating in the fall Steam Next Fest. For this event, I have prepared a new Beta version of the game that you can already play. I am grateful for everyone's support and help, I hope you enjoy it.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2587320/Hidden_Glade/
